Same tabletop robot kitchen scene and static camera as the start and end images. A white robot arm holds a pale kettle and pours hot dark-brown coffee. On the table: an open instant-coffee jar on the left and a clear drinking glass with reddish-brown coffee and a metal spoon on the right; a black gripper stays idle. Use exactly one continuous, unbranched coffee stream. Begin pouring into the right drinking glass. Then move the kettle spout left so the entire stream enters the open left coffee jar for about three seconds, wetting the granules, while zero new coffee enters the right glass. Then move that same stream back into the right glass and finish matching the end image. Never two streams, never pour into both vessels at once, and do not make a table spill the main event. No cuts, new objects, or camera motion.
